novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new measurement combination—“a mechanistic signature-combining a token's causal influence on the final logits and its information gain about the answer”—for identifying productive reasoning tokens online. Searches around “chain-of-thought token causal influence activation patching,” “reasoning-token productivity hidden-state probe,” and “step-level information gain reasoning” locate the closest work in When Chain-of-Thought Fails, the Solution Hides in the Hidden States (2026), which already reports unevenly distributed token-level task information using activation patching, alongside Hidden Error Awareness in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning (2026) and IGPO (2025) for online internal diagnostics and information-gain credit assignment. Combining these established components into a joint unsupervised productivity signature is a non-trivial operationalization, but the step is a natural extension rather than a new core mechanistic relationship, while monitoring and pruning are standard downstream uses of such scores.
